items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Die Frist von zwei Wochen beginnt mit dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: This is a formally served letter (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) with the delivery date stamped on the envelope copy: 'zugestellt am 21.11.2026' (a Saturday). No statutory deemed-delivery-by-post fiction applies because it was formally served; the stated delivery date is used as the anchor (receipt). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so counting starts 22.11.2026. A two-week (14-day) period under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends on the day of the second following week bearing the same name as the day of delivery: Saturday 05.12.2026. Since that day is a Saturday, § 193 BGB / § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG shifts the deadline to the next business day: Monday 07.12.2026. (No Brandenburg public holiday falls in between.)

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (Geldbuße, Gebühr, Auslagen) after Rechtskraft
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft zu zahlen.
items.computation: Rechtskraft (finality) of a Bußgeldbescheid occurs, absent an Einspruch, upon expiry of the two-week Einspruch period, i.e. at the end of 07.12.2026 (as computed above). Counting for the payment period then starts the next day, 08.12.2026 (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), and the two-week period ends two weeks later on Monday 21.12.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). That day is a normal working Monday in Brandenburg, so no further shift is needed. This date assumes no Einspruch is filed; filing one would stop Rechtskraft and this payment deadline would no longer apply.

warnings: The payment deadline (two weeks after Rechtskraft) is computed assuming no Einspruch is filed by 07.12.2026; if an Einspruch is filed in time, Rechtskraft does not occur and no payment is yet due.

The sender's email address domain ('zentraldienst-der-polizei-mu.example') uses the reserved '.example' top-level domain, which is not a real, deliverable domain — double-check this contact detail against an official, independently-found source before relying on it.

The IBAN printed (DE70 1600 0000 0005 8312 00) is well-formed and passes the checksum, but a valid IBAN does not prove who owns the account; before paying, confirm via an independent, trusted source (e.g. an official notice or the authority's known payment channel) that this is genuinely the correct account for Brandenburg's central Bußgeldstelle.
